title: The Pelican Nebula in Gas, Dust, and Stars
explanation:
# The Pelican Nebula's Cosmic Transformation

A massive cloud of gas and dust called the Pelican Nebula is being dramatically reshaped by radiation from newborn stars, which are slowly heating its cold gas and creating a bright orange boundary—visible in this incredibly detailed image made from 25 hours of telescope exposure—that advances like a slow-motion wave across the cosmic nursery. Over millions of years, this stellar forge will look completely different as the stars and gas rearrange themselves, eventually erasing any resemblance to the "pelican" shape that gives this nebula its name today.
